Mukesh Khanna Criticizes 'Ramayana' Film Portrayal of Sita

Actor Mukesh Khanna has criticized the upcoming film 'Ramayana', specifically objecting to a portrayal of the character Sita as a "fighter" and performing action scenes. Khanna stated that "Maa Sita was never a fighter," expressing disapproval of what he described as a "modern twist" to the character, reportedly played by Sai Pallavi. The film is also associated with actor Ranbir Kapoor.
